subject: mathematics
title: Percentages
summary: What per cent means, changing fractions to percentages, and finding a percentage of an amount.

lesson.text: Per cent means "out of 100". The sign is %. So 30% means 30 out of 100, or 30/100.
Make the bottom number 100, or multiply the fraction by 100.

lesson.title: Ngozi scored 18 out of 20. What percentage is that?

lesson.text: 10% is easy: divide by 10. Then 20% is double that, and 5% is half of it.

questions.prompt: Musa got 15 out of 20 in a test. What percentage is that?
A shirt costs ₦2,000. The shop takes 20% off. How much do you pay?
questions.explanation: 10% of ₦2,000 is ₦200, so 20% is ₦400. You pay ₦2,000 − ₦400 = ₦1,600. ₦400 is the discount, not the price.
